profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Product engineer with passionate vision for user-friendly web applications that can be extended with developer and business integrations. Proven track record connecting people and technologies in the worlds of healthcare, business, productivity, and education.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead engineer for GA release of Google Meet's Manual Face Match feature, taking full ownership of several implementation aspects and bug fixes to leading bug bashes and monitoring key metrics (see Google Workspace blog about feature: https://workspaceupdates.googleblog.com/2025/03/dynamic-layouts-for-google-meet.html)

positions.description: Skills: Project Management · TypeScript · Front-End Development · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead developer of Beta and GA releases for Lightning Message Service (LMS)
    - Integrated 3 generations of UI technologies to have a common communication framework 
  - Coordinator of cross-team design review, test, performance, and monitoring strategies, resulting in management and product stakeholder confidence to release
  - Developer Blog author onboarding customers and external devs to LMS concepts

• Developer integrating non-Lightning-native Web technologies (e.g. Classic server-side rendered Visualforce UIs) into the modern Lightning single page app
  - Intern project designer and mentor leading a cozy team to re-engineer a Canvas component using modern Platform techniques and solve customer pain points; organized cross-site summer extravaganza to demo & review ~30 intern projects with architects and executives
  - Automated tools to significantly speed up process of ensuring millions of customer Visualforce pages maintain consistency between releases, decreasing engineer time commitment from days to minutes.
  - Visualforce Family Reunion Organizer bringing together 10 Years of Visualforce engineers, managers, product managers, and VPs for a good ole time of food and bonding.

I also enjoy mentoring early professionals  in my spare time, participated in Fall 2017 UNCF Innovation Summit, 2019 NSBE National Convention, recruiting, teaching, clear documentation and the occasional hackathon!

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Developed an online tool for teachers to retrieve reports about the performance of their students  enrolled in CMU's Carnegie Cadets program (www.carnegiecyberacademy.com/)
• Interfaced a new Ruby on Rails application with an existing production MySQL database and legacy PHP code
• Built complex, efficient, and scalable SQL queries

positions.title: Extreme Blue Technical Intern
positions.description:
Designed and implemented modern graphical enhancements to the WebSphere Application Server console, using treemaps, that allow system administrators to intuitively visualize and perform operations on large-scale application server infrastructures
• Utilized and extended the open source Dojo Toolkit, esp. its cross-platform vector graphics API
• Led the push to make use of emerging HTML5 technologies like <canvas> for complex dynamic  data visualization
• Presented to executives and interacted directly with clients to ensure requirement satisfaction
• Established connections with IBM's web security experts in the WebSphere group and IBM's data visualization experts involved in the Many Eyes research project to discuss topics relevant to our project

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a web portal to serve as the remote interface to a performance benchmarking system that reserves machines for customized tests
• Became familiar with HTTP REST services
• Server-side processing with JSP and client-side AJAX with jQuery
• Exercised database design and querying skills

company.name: STEM Learning Community at Florida A&M University

positions.title: STEM Mentor, Technology Chair
positions.description:
Brought a computer techy presence to a community full of chemistry, biology, math, and engineering majors
• Spearheaded an effort to develop an academia-focused web application for entry into Oracle's ThinkQuest Competition, leading a group of students with no previous programming experience
• Assembled a team of students to construct a 3D model of STEM headquarters (using Google Sketchup) from group-taken dimensions, which we used to virtually redesign the space
• Frequently tutored C/C++ and Physics

positions.title: Academic Tutor
positions.description:
Assisted fellow students in C/C++ Programming, Linear Algebra, Circuits, Physics I-II, Calc I-III,
General Chemistry
• Exercised effective communication skills

positions.title: Entertainment Product Specialist
positions.description:
Became an expert on consumer electronics and helped customers make informed decisions on the best product(s) for their purpose
• Helped sell thousands of dollars worth of merchandise a day
• Maintained product displays and visual / auditory atmosphere

volunteerExperiences.description: During Spring Break 2006, traveled with my Junior ROTC unit to Biloxi, Mississippi, to assist with the disaster relief efforts after Hurricane Katrina; went around a few communities in the city and cleaned up manageable, but damaging, debris; gutted houses to prep them for renovation

As a part of a grant from State Farm, helped design and implement programs with the Florida A&M Honor Student Association to enhance financial literacy of middle and high school students in Tallahassee, Florida

projects.title: Apportable
projects.description:
In this graduate capstone practicum project, my team of fellow students worked with a Silicon Valley client, Apportable Inc., applying our skills to 1) improving their software engine that automatically ports iOS games to Android and 2) enhancing their website to attract more clients and make the developer SDK version of the porting engine downloadable.
We also had the unique opportunity to participate in some of the business discussions and helped develop the tiered pricing strategy for the nascent SDK.

projects.title: Atlas
projects.description: The Atlas project at IBM centered around giving system administrators the power to intuitively visualize and perform operations on large-scale, diverse application server infrastructures. It provides dynamic visualization and management capabilities for growing WebSphere Application Server (WAS) environments that make complex, time-consuming system administrative tasks simple and precise. This next generation scalable, extensible UI emerged alongside the recently introduced lightweight Liberty profile for WAS.

patents.title: Audio menu navigation and option selection via display device
patents.description: To support audio menu navigation and option selection via display device, a communication connection between an automated voice menu system and a user device is established, one or more option selections corresponding to a menu of options are determined, a user interface including an arrangement of elements corresponding to the one or more option selections is generated at the user device, an input from a user is received via the user interface, and a response is transmitted from the user device to the automated voice menu system.

patents.title: Exposing Fragment Identifiers
patents.description: A method for exposing fragment identifiers within an information resource, such as a Web document
